subject: POC load allowance expansion request - Lakeside Health
messages:
From: Caroline Hayes <caroline@lakesidehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@lakesidehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: POC load allowance expansion request - Lakeside Health

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency figures on short-context queries. We’re approaching the next phase of our POC (throughput validation across 200k concurrent short calls/day) and the current trial allocation is going to fall short.

Attached is our load plan (lakeside_poc_load_plan.xlsx) and the vendor-request form signed by procurement (request_form_signed.pdf). High level ask: can Redwood expand our trial allowance by ~150k token-units for a 48-hour stress window the week of Nov 30 so we can validate end-to-end latency under peak load?

Key constraints:
- Data residency: tests must run in us-west region.
- No persistent data retention beyond 7 days.
- We’ll coordinate with your SE for throttling patterns.

Can you confirm what you’ll need from us to approve this? If it helps, I can loop in our security contact.

Appreciate it —
Caroline Hayes
Senior Platform Engineer
Lakeside Health

Attachments: lakeside_poc_load_plan.xlsx (xlsx), request_form_signed.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Hayes <caroline@lakesidehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC load allowance expansion request - Lakeside Health

Hi Caroline — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the plan. I’ve attached it to the record and looped in Marissa (SE lead) and Ben (Customer Success) so we can cover security and the operational window.

Quick responses to your bullets:
- Region: we can spin up a us-west instance for the test window.
- Retention: we can set a temporary 7-day retention and confirm in writing.
- Throttling: Marissa will propose the best burst policy so you get realistic tail-latency numbers.

Marissa/Ben — can you confirm capacity and whether we need a short billing addendum for the 150k token-units? If so, happy to fast-track approval.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Mon 11/23 to align test cadence and SLOs. Caroline — what time window works for you?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0192

> Attachment: lakeside_poc_load_plan.xlsx (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Caroline Hayes <caroline@lakesidehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC load allowance expansion request - Lakeside Health

Thanks all — had a quick look through the plan. Technically this is straightforward; the main gating item is a short-term credit allowance and a formal test window so we can reserve capacity.

Proposal:
- Grant a one-time promotional allowance of 150k token-units for a 48-hour window starting 2026-11-30 00:00 PST.
- Apply a temporary reservation on our us-west pool for that window (we’ll reduce other bursts).
- Security confirmation: Caroline, we’ll accept the 7-day retention constraint and will limit logs/archives accordingly; please send the contact for your security/compliance person so we have it on file.

Ben — from CS/finance perspective, is a signed addendum required for this promotional allowance, or can we approve internally and document it post-run? I’d prefer to avoid delaying the test.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
